datasets.name: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the DRC by province (INSP situation reports)
datasets.description: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak figures for provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, taken from the situation reports (SitReps) published by the Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP): running totals of confirmed Ebola cases and of deaths attributed to Ebola, the number of health zones reporting at least one case, the total number of health zones and the health zones newly reporting a case in the previous 24 hours, by province and report date. Country figures for the DRC are the sum of the affected provinces.

datasets.name: CO2 emissions per capita (Our World in Data)
datasets.description: Annual carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions per person from burning fossil fuels and industrial processes (transport, electricity generation, heating, cement), excluding land-use change, in tonnes of CO2 per person. Emissions come from the Global Carbon Project's Global Carbon Budget and are divided by population estimates from multiple sources; compiled and processed by Our World in Data for every country and the World.

datasets.name: World Development Indicators
datasets.description: World Development Indicators (WDI) is the World Bank's primary collection of development indicators, compiled from officially recognised international sources. It presents current and accurate global development data for more than 200 economies, including national, regional and global estimates.
